description: This file defines the 'AddBinary' class, which represents a binary addition operation node within the Twig templating engine's abstract syntax tree.

classes.name: AddBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary addition node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, extending AbstractBinary and implementing the operator method to output the '+' operator.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the compiler object with the raw '+' operator appended, facilitating code generation for addition.
